summary: The script runs and is syntactically sound with robust CLI, error handling, and a working minimal agent-based simulation. However, it does not implement several core entities, interactions, parameters, and metrics specified in the task (e.g., venues with mandates and enforcement, mask types and supply constraints, information environment dynamics, adoption by venue type, mask access gap, mask type distribution). There are also performance concerns in the small-world rewiring step and a minor logic issue with unbounded peer influence input.

issues.description: Missing entities and behaviors specified in the task: Venue (with type, capacity, mandate/enforcement), PolicyMaker with threshold-based mandates, MaskSupply with mask types/inventory/prices/restock by type, and InformationEnvironment with risk_signal/misinformation/news_salience. The current Government, Retailer, and MediaChannel do not cover these requirements.
issues.location: Classes and interactions throughout the code (no Venue, MaskSupply with types, or InformationEnvironment per spec)
issues.solution: Implement classes Venue, PolicyMaker, MaskSupply (with inventory_by_type, restock_rate_by_type, price_by_type), and InformationEnvironment; wire them into the daily step: attendance_and_contact_formation, policy_enforcement_at_venues, policy_broadcast, information_broadcast, and mask_acquisition.

issues.description: Mask types and related behaviors/metrics are not implemented. The simulation uses a single generic mask inventory without cloth/surgical/N95 distinctions.
issues.solution: Introduce mask_type for individuals, track inventory_by_type, allow purchase decisions across types based on price and cost sensitivity, implement MaskSupply with type-level restocking and pricing, and compute mask_type_distribution and mask_access_gap metrics.

issues.description: Venue attendance and contact formation is not modeled. Social contacts occur via a static social network, but there is no attendance of different venue types with contact_rate_modifiers and enforcement at venues.
issues.solution: Add a Venue layer with types (household, workplace, school, retail, transit, recreation), capacities, and contact modifiers. Each day, sample attendance per person by routine and form contacts through venues. Aggregate adoption_by_venue_type and enforce venue mandates.

issues.description: Key metrics from the spec are missing or only partially approximated: adoption_by_venue_type, mask_access_gap, mask_type_distribution, policy_impact_on_adoption (only approximated), sustained_adoption_post_policy (approximated as sustained_adoption_rate but not aligned to lifting conditions).
issues.solution: Compute per-venue adoption rates, mask_access_gap (share of agents intending to wear a mask but lacking inventory), mask_type_distribution, and align policy_impact_on_adoption and sustained_adoption_post_policy to mandate issue/lift events.

issues.description: Peer influence term passed to evaluate_mask_use_decision can exceed [0,1] because it sums weighted peer and household components without clamping, affecting the utility beyond intended range.
issues.location: Simulation.step -> decision call: peer_share=peer_w * peer_share + household_w * self._household_norm_component(p)
issues.solution: Clamp the combined peer/household influence into [0,1] before passing to evaluate_mask_use_decision: peer_component = _clamp(peer_w * peer_share + household_w * hh_component, 0.0, 1.0).

issues.description: Fine amount and penalties are defined but not applied to any cost or behavioral update when enforcing mandates.
issues.solution: When an enforcement action occurs, apply a penalty (e.g., track economic cost or adjust compliance_propensity based on fine_amount and enforcement_strength).

issues.description: Small-world rewiring builds a large set of all node indices for every potential rewiring, which is O(N) per rewiring and costly for large N (e.g., 10k).
issues.location: Simulation.initialize -> small-world rewiring: candidates = set(range(self.N)) - {i} - set(ring[i])
issues.solution: Avoid reconstructing the full set each time. Sample new_j via repeated random selection until not in current neighbors and not i (bounded retries), or precompute a global set once and reuse neighbor sets to compute membership without creating large temporary sets.

issues.description: Evaluation metric naming is partially aliased but does not include all spec metrics or may return structures different from spec expectations.
issues.solution: Expand alias mapping and implement missing metrics per spec; ensure return types match descriptions (e.g., value-only for peak_adoption_rate and lists/dicts as specified).

issues.description: Initial mandate_active series value may not reflect the computed mandate status at day 0 if start/end do not include 0.
issues.solution: Call government.issue_or_lift_mandate(0) before initializing mandate_active series.
